keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Ronald Araujo (Liverpool) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.

Goal! Crystal Palace 0, Liverpool 1. Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) header from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Dominik Szoboszlai with a cross following a set piece situation.
Delay in match because of an injury Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Crystal Palace 0, Liverpool 1.
Goal! Crystal Palace 0, Liverpool 2. Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Bradley Barcola with a cross.
Delay in match because of an injury Jérémy Jacquet (Liverpool).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Bradley Barcola (Liverpool) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Crystal Palace. Darío Osorio replaces Quinten Timber.
Substitution, Liverpool. Víctor Muñoz replaces Bradley Barcola.
Substitution, Liverpool. Trey Nyoni replaces Dominik Szoboszlai.
Yéremy Pino (Crystal Palace) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Crystal Palace. Eddie Nketiah replaces Jørgen Strand Larsen.
Substitution, Liverpool. Rio Ngumoha replaces Cody Gakpo.
Víctor Muñoz (Liverpool) is shown the yellow card.
Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) is shown the yellow card.
Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Crystal Palace. Anan Khalaili replaces Óscar Mingueza.
Substitution, Crystal Palace. Dwight McNeil replaces Yéremy Pino.
Goal! Crystal Palace 0, Liverpool 3. Alexander Isak (Liverpool) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Florian Wirtz following a fast break.
Substitution, Liverpool. Lewis Koumas replaces Alexander Isak.
Substitution, Liverpool. Joe Gomez replaces Ronald Araujo.
Goal! Crystal Palace 1, Liverpool 3. Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
